LATEST BUSINESS UPDATE FOR THE THIRD QUARTER OF 2026
This announcement is made by the board of directors (the “Board”) of Pop Mart International
Group Limited (the “Company”, together with its subsidiaries and consolidated affiliated entities,
the “Group”) on a voluntary basis to inform the shareholders of the Company and potential
investors about the latest business update of the Group.
Overall and Regional Revenue Performance in the Third Quarter of 2026
Overall revenue (unaudited) for the third quarter of 2026 recorded a period-on-period decrease
of 45%-50% as compared to the third quarter of 2025, among which, revenue attributed from
operations in the PRC recorded a period-on-period decrease of 25%-30%, revenue attributed from
operations in Asia-Pacific1 recorded a period-on-period decrease of 65%-70%, revenue attributed
from operations in America recorded a period-on-period decrease of 70%-75%, and revenue
attributed from operations in Europe and other regions recorded a period-on-period decrease of
Revenue Performance by Each Respective Channel of Operations in the PRC in the Third
Quarter of 2026
The revenue (unaudited) attributed from each respective channel of the operations in the PRC for
the third quarter of 2026 as compared to the third quarter of 2025 is as follows:
(1) for offline channels, a period-on-period decrease of 5%-10% was recorded; and
(2) for online channels, a period-on-period decrease of 45%-50% was recorded.
1 Refers to other countries and regions in Asia and Oceania other than the PRC
